examples.label: Blog card footer with author and read time
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-card" site="Global" id="showcase-cf-blog" rounded="large" padding="large" space="small" class="max-w-sm"> <.component component_name="chelekom-card-title" site="Global" id="showcase-cf-blog-title" title="Why we stopped writing custom CSS" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-card-content" site="Global" id="showcase-cf-blog-body"> <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small"> Two years of utility classes later, the stylesheet is 40 lines long and nobody has opened it since March. <.component component_name="chelekom-card-footer" site="Global" id="showcase-cf-blog-footer">
<.component component_name="chelekom-avatar" site="Global" src="/images/avatar4.jpg" size="extra_small" rounded="full" />
Shahryar Tavakkoli
6 min read

examples.label: Confirmation card footer with cancel and delete actions
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-card" site="Global" id="showcase-cf-confirm" rounded="large" padding="large" space="small" class="max-w-md"> <.component component_name="chelekom-card-title" site="Global" id="showcase-cf-confirm-title" title="Delete this collection?" icon="hero-shield-check" size="medium" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-card-content" site="Global" id="showcase-cf-confirm-body"> <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small"> The 34 posts inside it stay published, but they lose this collection and any menu link pointing at it. This cannot be undone. <.component component_name="chelekom-card-footer" site="Global" id="showcase-cf-confirm-footer">
<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="outline" color="natural" type="button" size="medium">Keep it <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" color="danger" type="button" size="medium">Delete collection
